timeline.summary: Juniper Hotels received an income tax demand notice of ₹25.83 Cr for AY 2023-24 citing under-reporting of income.
Juniper Hotels submitted its monitoring agency report for Q4 FY26, confirming full utilization of ₹1,800 Cr IPO proceeds.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹301.48 Cr (+8.6% YoY), net profit ₹50.38 Cr (-8.3% YoY).
Juniper Hotels announced Q4 and FY26 financial results, reporting total income of ₹1,069 Cr and receiving a DDA Letter of Award for a ~500-key luxury hotel in New Delhi.
Juniper Hotels paid a ₹4.60 lakh fine each to NSE and BSE for a past board composition delay and confirmed current compliance.
Juniper Hotels approved the acquisition of 100% equity in JHAPL for ₹1 lakh to develop a 5-star hotel in Dwarka, New Delhi.
Juniper Hotels Limited’s Sandeep L. Joshi, Compliance Officer, disclosed the earnings conference call recording for Q4-FY2026 results on May 21, 2026, at 4:30 PM (IST).
Juniper Hotels reported Q4 and FY26 financial results with operating revenue of ₹1,047.7 Cr and outlined expansion plans targeting 3,320 keys by FY30.
Juniper Hotels executed a Share Purchase Agreement on June 2, 2026, to acquire 100% of JHAPL for developing a 5-star hotel in Dwarka, New Delhi.
Juniper Hotels Limited informed the Exchanges of the outcome of its Analyst & Investor Meeting held on 23 October 2026.
